messages:
deploybot: Promote blocked: canary deploy for release v3.7.2 failed checks. Pipeline 45012 reported job 'build:image-publish' failed. Holding promotion.

alice (release): Ugh. Canary failing on image unpack step again. Any quick context?

ben (eng): Saw same on my local. Runner fails while extracting layer, permission denied writing to /var/lib/docker/overlay2: 
```
ERROR: error extracting layer: lchown /var/lib/docker/overlay2/xyz/merged/opt/bin/tool: operation not permitted
```

carmen (infra): That's the root cause. Self-hosted runners had a kernel upgrade last night that tightened userns/overlayfs xattr handling. Some older image layers with root-owned xattrs fail to be applied. Our remote cache returns the same tarball so every CI runner re-extracts and hits same error.

dave (build): Confirmation: cache hit returns artifact sha256:aa7f... and when I pulled and ran `docker load` on a GCP-hosted runner it succeeds. The failure is specific to onprem runners with overlayfs + userns.

erin (qa): Canary traffic flagged errors 502s from the canary pods that couldn't start due to image unpack errors. We tailed logs and got same lchown error. Canary has ~1200 requests, ~8% error rate now.

frank (oncall): Short-term options: 1) rollback canary to v3.7.1 (safe), 2) re-run pipeline forcing fresh image repack without preserving xattrs, 3) spin canary in GCP runners while infra patch rolls out. Thoughts?

alice (release): We need a decision fast. We don't want this to block the cut longer than the change window. What's lowest-risk?

ben (eng): Low risk = rollback to v3.7.1 and mark release hold. Medium = repack image removing problematic xattrs and promote once validated. High risk = force-run on different runner fleet (GCP) since that changes runtime.

carmen (infra): We're already prepping a kernel revert for the affected runners but that will take ~90m with rolling reboots. We can exempt canary by routing its pipeline to cloud runners but that requires a small infra ACL change.

dave (build): I can trigger a job that runs `docker save | tar --no-xattrs` to produce a sanitized tarball and publish a parallel tag `v3.7.2-sanitized` — gives us a quick canary test without changing existing artifact.

erin (qa): If we test `v3.7.2-sanitized` and it passes, we can promote. QA needs a clean run: `ci pipeline --tag v3.7.2-sanitized` and smoke tests.

frank (oncall): Proposal: rollback canary to v3.7.1 immediately to stop user impact, then run dave's sanitized-publish path, test on GCP runners, and once green, update release notes and promote sanitized image. I'll own the rollback now.

alice (release): +1. Do it. Frank, please post timeline in #incidents if rollout spans >30m.

deploybot: Manual promote canceled by frank (oncall). Canary rolled back to image v3.7.1. Incident ticket INC-2026 created.

dave (build): Starting sanitized publish now. Command: `make publish-image TAG=v3.7.2-sanitized NO_XATTRS=1` (will push to staging registry). ETA ~18m.

ben (eng): After publish, I'll trigger canary pipeline on cloud runners: `ci run --canary --tag v3.7.2-sanitized --runners=cloud`

erin (qa): I'll run smoke and load tests on that canary. If <1% error and latency within SLOs, QA signoff.

carmen (infra): Rolling kernel revert still happening for onprem fleet; ETA 1h. We'll annotate deploybot routing once revert completes.

alice (release): Add a note in the release PR: explain transient runner kernel issues and that we published a sanitized image; include CI steps to reproduce and the hotfix checklist. I'll update notes after QA signoff.

frank (oncall): Logging timeline here: rollback done (2432109900), dave publish started (2432109920), canary on cloud triggered (2432109950). Will update when QA completes.

deploybot: Pipeline 45015 (canary v3.7.2-sanitized) started on cloud runners.

erin (qa): Smoke tests passing so far (5/5), load test running. If load stays stable for 10m, I'll mark signoff.

ben (eng): Also adding a temporary CI rule to prefer cloud runners for image-publish job until infra confirms kernel revert. `ci: publish - prefers: cloud`

alice (release): Thanks everyone. Once QA signoff, we publish a short note in release notes and unhold promotion.

erin (qa): Load stable. Signoff: QA ✅. No image unpack errors observed on cloud runners.

frank (oncall): Unhold planned. Wait 5m to ensure no rollout flakiness, then promote sanitized image as the release artifact.

deploybot: Promotion requested by alice (release) for tag v3.7.2-sanitized. Starting rollout.

alice (release): Postmortem action items: 1) add runner-label gating for image extraction compatibility, 2) add `tar --no-xattrs` repack step as fallback in publish pipeline, 3) update runbook for kernel upgrades. Will create issues.

ben (eng): I'll follow up with a small CI change to detect xattr-heavy layers earlier in build pipeline.

carmen (infra): We'll accelerate kernel fix for remaining runners and notify ops.

frank (oncall): Closing incident when rollout completes and canary metrics stable for 30m. Will file INC-2026 update. :white_check_mark:
